sn35.156:1.1: bhikkhave cakkhuṃ Aniccanti passati || sāyaṃ hoti sammādiṭṭhi ||
sn35.156:1.6: Aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu sotaṃ Aniccanti passati || ghānaṃ Aniccanti passati || jivham Aniccanti passati ||
sn35.156:1.11: Aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu manaṃ Aniccanti passati || sāyaṃ hoti sammādiṭṭhi ||
